description: This file defines the 'nusoap_client' class, a PHP implementation for a SOAP client facilitating communication with SOAP web services. It includes methods for making calls, handling WSDL, managing cookies, setting proxies and credentials, and lower-level transport functions. The class extends 'nusoap_base' and provides a higher-level abstraction over SOAP interactions, supporting features like proxies, persistent connections, encoding options, and dynamic proxy class generation.

classes.name: nusoap_client
classes.description: High-level SOAP client class for invoking methods on SOAP servers, handling WSDL, and managing communication details.

classes.name: soapclient
classes.description: Backward compatibility class alias for 'nusoap_client' if the PHP SOAP extension is not loaded.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the SOAP client with endpoint, WSDL, proxy, timeout, and other configurations.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Performs the SOAP method call with specified parameters, handling serialization, envelope creation, and response parsing.

methods.name: checkWSDL
methods.description: Validates and loads WSDL operations, setting binding type accordingly.

methods.name: loadWSDL
methods.description: Instantiates the WSDL object and fetches/loads the WSDL file.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Retrieves operation-specific data from the WSDL, such as input parts and endpoint.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends SOAP message over HTTP/HTTPS, manages transport, and processes response.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response, extracts encoding, and decodes SOAP message.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets a cURL option for HTTP transport.

methods.name: setEndpoint
methods.description: Overrides the default endpoint URL.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets SOAP headers for the request.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves SOAP response headers.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed SOAP response header.

methods.name: setHTTPProxy
methods.description: Configures proxy server settings.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication credentials.

methods.name: setHTTPEncoding
methods.description: Sets HTTP encoding (gzip, deflate, etc.).

methods.name: setUseCURL
methods.description: Enables or disables use of cURL for transport.

methods.name: useHTTPPersistentConnection
methods.description: Enables persistent HTTP connections.

methods.name: getDefaultRpcParams
methods.description: Deprecated; supposed to get default RPC parameters setting.

methods.name: setDefaultRpcParams
methods.description: Deprecated; intended to set default RPC parameters setting.

methods.name: getProxy
methods.description: Dynamically generates a PHP proxy class for WSDL operations for easier method calls.

methods.name: _getProxyClassCode
methods.description: Generates the PHP code for the proxy class.

methods.name: getProxyClassCode
methods.description: Returns the generated proxy class code.

methods.name: getHTTPBody
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTTP payload for the SOAP message.

methods.name: getHTTPContentType
methods.description: Returns the HTTP Content-Type header value.

methods.name: getHTTPContentTypeCharset
methods.description: Returns charset for the HTTP Content-Type.

methods.name: decodeUTF8
methods.description: Configures whether to decode UTF8 elements.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the internal cookie store.

methods.name: getCookies
methods.description: Retrieves all stored cookies.

methods.name: checkCookies
methods.description: Removes expired cookies.

methods.name: UpdateCookies
methods.description: Merges new cookies into existing store.
